query: I'm new to Qovery, help me get started — I'm a solo founder, no cloud experience
expected_behavior: Loads reference/phase1-understand-user.md and asks the user about role, experience, industry, and constraints in conversational groups
Recommends a managed cluster on AWS (or Scaleway if EU compliance is mentioned) — does NOT push BYOK on a beginner
Recommends a 3-environment structure (development / staging / production) per reference/phase2-recommend-setup.md
Bakes in security defaults (private DB, internal networking, secrets encryption) WITHOUT presenting them as options
Walks the user through cloud credential setup via reference/phase3-execute-setup.md and uses CloudFormation quick-create for AWS
Uses complete Console links with verified IDs for the cluster list and deployment rules, or falls back to the Console root with UI navigation when an ID is unavailable

query: I have an existing EKS cluster — can I use Qovery on it?
expected_behavior: Confirms the existing cluster matches Qovery's minimum requirements (version, node count, ingress, etc.)
Loads reference/phase4-byok.md and walks through `qovery cluster install`
Does NOT offer to create a managed cluster (the user already has one)
Verifies the cluster is registered in Qovery before proceeding to project/environment setup

query: I'm migrating from Heroku — I have 12 apps and a bunch of config vars
expected_behavior: Loads reference/phase5-migration-guides.md and walks the Heroku-specific path
Maps Heroku concepts to Qovery (dyno -> service, addon -> database, config var -> env var)
Uses `qovery env parse --heroku-json` to import config vars in bulk rather than one by one
Recommends a phased migration (one app at a time, staging first) instead of a big bang
Hands off to qovery-deploy once the platform is set up

query: Connect my GitHub organization to Qovery. My Qovery organization ID is 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000 — give me the direct Console link.
expected_behavior: Uses the organization ID in the exact Console URL `https://console.qovery.com/organization/123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000/settings/git-repository-access`
Recommends a GitHub organization token and does not recommend installing the deprecated Qovery GitHub App
Explains the required GitHub token permissions or links to the Git Repository Access documentation
Does not emit the invalid ID-less route `https://console.qovery.com/organization/settings/git-repository-access`
